links.outcome: Error detection rate, false positives, and processing time of GPT-4 versus six pathologists on the same reports
links.effect: GPT-4 detected 88% of errors (350/400) vs 95% (382/400) for the top senior pathologist; 4.03 s vs 65.64 s per report; false positives 2.3% vs 0.3%.
links.quote: GPT-4 detected 88% of errors (350/400; 95% CI: [84, 91]), compared to a 95% detection rate by the top senior pathologist (382/400; 95% CI: [93, 97]).

screen.reason: Empirical study comparing GPT-4's ability to detect synthetic errors in pathology reports against human pathologists, but it benchmarks standalone model performance without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
